name: bandit.r033_registered_smoke_proximity_dedup_mcw
description: R-033 paired-site proximity successor. It evaluates exactly one native active smoke source at the staffed camp's own OMT: first positive smoke signal lead creation, then unchanged-source dedup. Only a matching signal-origin smoke lead counts; terrain opportunities are confounds.

proof_gates.label: R-033 proximity smoke reaches one current source-bound live session

steps.label: audit_r033_native_smoke_source_footing
steps.abort_reason: the disposable v7 fixture did not install one live-accessible wielded inactive smoke grenade

steps.label: move_r033_smoke_source_to_staffed_camp_omt
steps.objective: Use only advertised native movement actions to bring the wielded source into OMT [140,40,0].

steps.label: align_r033_native_smoke_source_to_next_staffed_cadence
steps.objective: Use only advertised native waits while the source is still inactive, placing native activation immediately before the next five-minute staffed-observer cadence.

steps.label: operate_r033_registered_smoke_proximity_dedup
steps.objective: Use the current native inventory descriptor to identify the wielded smokebomb by its advertised item owner, select that exact per-run stable ID, and activate it through the native item menu. Then bind paired sites/member 18 and the first source in OMT [140,40,0]. First cadence must create zero sites and create a smoke-signal lead matching channel smoke and signal origin. For the changed-source control, move the avatar one tile east into OMT [141,40,0] while the observer camp anchor remains [140,40,0], refresh the live inventory descriptor, and activate only the currently advertised wielded smoke item no earlier than one native minute before the next staffed cadence; do not reuse a prior item/action stable ID. The second source counts only when the authoritative R008 record has smoke observed=true with source_omt [141,40,0], a viable positive range cap, and the staffed-camp callback has camp/source distance 1 and clear LOS. If that source predicate is absent, retain the no-source control and do not call it a refresh or dedup result.

second_source_control.activation_window: one native game minute before the next five-minute staffed cadence
source_predicates: staffed callback observer=18 eligible and at_home
second_source_control.stale_selector_policy: refresh descriptor and choose current advertised wielded item/action stable IDs

proof_targets: paired registered-site identities and observer identity
verified terrain/source coordinates, scanner range, and camp/source OMT coincidence
zero site creation at first cadence
native activation of the current wielded smoke item using its advertised stable ID
first exact smoke-only R008 and positive source-matched callback/lead
changed-source refresh at adjacent OMT with exact source predicate
same-source unchanged/dedup only after the changed-source refresh is independently bound
sound/light absence and filtered signal-lead count/hash at boundaries
authority: advertised native actions and worker-chosen bounded waits
invariants: registration and item activation are zero-credit
source movement and cadence boundaries must be native
terrain-opportunity leads never count as a signal result
do not treat presentation as callback evidence
never reuse stale inventory or item-menu stable IDs

evidence_contract.claim: one source-bound R-033 run supplies only native smoke-to-matching-signal-lead and same-source dedup facts after paired sites are registered
evidence_contract.failure_rule: a first-cadence site creation, conflating source, missing binding, no positive source-matched callback, or changed signal lead identity leaves the claim unproved
